vulnerabilities.verification: Range validation: regex for positive integer; bounds check: [0, current_time]; early exit on failure

vulnerabilities.title: Unvalidated JSON Parsing
vulnerabilities.rationale: Data comes from internal Redis storage (not untrusted source); fallback to empty arrays on missing data; crashes acceptable over silent corruption

vulnerabilities.title: Unbounded Redis Keys Query
vulnerabilities.rationale: Phase 4 scale: <10K patterns acceptable; KEYS command acceptable for mid-phase architecture; monitoring via verbose logging

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Pattern Type Whitelist
vulnerabilities.rationale: Pattern type is filter parameter, not security boundary; invalid types result in empty sync (no data corruption); actual validation at ID level (Fix #5)
